question.en: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
question.zh: 牧师为什么拒绝砍掉这棵树？

sentences.en: Why does the vicar refuse to cut down the tree?
sentences.zh: 牧师为什么拒绝砍掉这棵树？

sentences.en: The tiny village of Frinley is said to possess a 'cursed tree'.
sentences.zh: 据说弗林利这个小村庄有一棵“被诅咒的树”。

sentences.en: Because the tree was mentioned in a newspaper,
sentences.zh: 因为报纸上提到了这棵树，

sentences.en: the number of visitors to Frinley has now increased.
sentences.zh: 现在来弗林利的游客增加了。

sentences.en: The tree was planted near the church fifty years ago,
sentences.zh: 这棵树是五十年前种在教堂附近的，

sentences.en: but it is only in recent years that it has gained an evil reputation.
sentences.zh: 但只是近几年才有了坏名声。

chunks.x: that it has gained an evil reputation

sentences.en: It is said that if anyone touches the tree,
sentences.zh: 据说谁要是碰了这棵树，

chunks.x: that if anyone touches the tree

sentences.en: he will have bad luck; if he picks a leaf, he will die.
sentences.zh: 就会倒霉；谁要是摘下一片叶子，就会死去。

sentences.en: Many villagers believe that the tree has already claimed a number of victims.
sentences.zh: 许多村民相信这棵树已经使好几个人丧了命。

chunks.x: that the tree has already claimed a number of victims

sentences.en: The vicar has been asked to have the tree cut down,
sentences.zh: 有人要求牧师把树砍掉，

sentences.en: but so far he has refused.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止他都拒绝了。

sentences.en: He has pointed out that the tree is a useful source of income,
sentences.zh: 他指出这棵树是一笔可观的收入来源，

chunks.x: that the tree is a useful source of income

sentences.en: as tourists have been coming from all parts of the country to see it.
sentences.zh: 因为全国各地的游客都来参观它。

chunks.x: from all parts of the country

sentences.en: In spite of all that has been said,

chunks.x: In spite of all that has been said
of all that has been said

sentences.pat: 非完整句（碎片/解析待核）

sentences.en: the tourists have been picking leaves and cutting their names on the tree-trunk.
sentences.zh: 游客们还是不断地摘树叶，在树干上刻自己的名字。

sentences.en: So far, not one of them has been struck down by sudden death!
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，还没有一个人突然死去！
